systemName: GBS MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (Global Brightest Stars Educational Management System)

subscriptionPricingMemory.policyTitle: OFFICIAL GBS STUDENT-BASED SUBSCRIPTION PRICING POLICY (Revised GBS Developer Policy)
subscriptionPricingMemory.pricingPrinciple: 100% student-based subscription model. NO fixed tenant fees, NO basic package fees, NO additional monthly access charges. Inactive, deleted, and archived students do not attract charges.
subscriptionPricingMemory.formula: monthlyCharge = activeStudents * ratePerStudent; grossTotal = monthlyCharge * months; discountAmount = grossTotal * (discountPct / 100); netTotalPayment = grossTotal - discountAmount
subscriptionPricingMemory.populationGrowthPolicy: Subscription amount increases or decreases on future invoices according to the institution's active student population (e.g., 200->300 increases next billing; 500->400 decreases next billing). Previously paid subscription periods are never retrospectively changed.

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Tenant Onboarding First Page
keyBehaviors: Displays GBS MANAGEMENT SYSTEM + crest logo on top center with Golden, Wine-Brown, Grey, and Sky-Blue gradient.
Includes 'I am already in' button and inscription dropdown that takes existing tenants straight to /login.
Auto-redirects already onboarded/approved tenants (gbs_tenant_onboarded === 'true') straight to /login.
Headmaster Face Camera Scanner captures and saves base64 photo to Developer verification queue.
Password match validator + eye visibility toggles.
Global network carrier auto-detection (+233 MTN/Telecel/AirtelTigo, +234, +1, +44, +254, +27).

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Main Login & Role Login Pages
keyBehaviors: Authenticates all roles with zero 30000ms timeout (instant hybrid local-cloud fallback).
Provides direct role portal cards and online admission access.

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Developer Control Center
keyBehaviors: Displays pending tenant onboarding registrations with captured Headmaster facial photo.
Approves or denies tenant applications and dispatches valid OTP via SMS/Email/WhatsApp.
Includes draggable image-based Movable AI Assistant (DeveloperMovableAIAssistant.jsx).
Controls tenant subscriptions, system locks, backups, deployments, and security alerts.

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Headmaster / Admin Dashboard
keyBehaviors: Manages admissions, staff approvals, academic year/term schedules, student promotions, emergency locator, and subscription renewal.

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Teacher Dashboard
keyBehaviors: Includes Class Topic Video Platform (ClassTopicVideoPlatform.jsx) in 'TEACHER' mode to upload/record topic videos for students to watch in the teacher's absence.
Manages daily attendance registers, assignments, exams, result entry, and AI OMR exam sheet scanning.

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Student Dashboard
keyBehaviors: Includes Class Topic Video Platform (ClassTopicVideoPlatform.jsx) in 'STUDENT' mode to play/watch teacher topic videos, adjust playback speed, mark as watched, and post questions/feedback.
Displays class timetable, homework submissions, online exams, and verified report cards.

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Parent Dashboard
keyBehaviors: Displays ward attendance, academic progress, transcript requests, PTA meetings, and fee invoice payments.

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Accountant / Finance Dashboard
keyBehaviors: Manages fee invoices, payments, scholarships, payroll generation, and GAAP/IFRS financial audits.

dashboardsAndRoutesMemory.name: Staff & HR Dashboard
keyBehaviors: Manages staff attendance, leave applications, salary grouping, loans, and campus operations.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Can't reach database server at localhost:5432 or Invalid prisma.<model>.<method>() invocation
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Local PostgreSQL service on port 5432 is stopped/offline or a service file instantiated its own new PrismaClient() instead of using the shared hybrid engine.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: backend/src/core/database/prisma.client.js intercepts all Prisma model methods and raw SQL queries via executeLocalPrismaQuery() and handleRawSqlOffline(), persisting data in backend/data/gbs_persistent_store.json. All services must import prisma from core/database/prisma.client.js.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Login or registration hangs and displays 'timeout of 30000ms exceeded'
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Backend auth/onboarding controller waiting indefinitely on an unreachable PostgreSQL connection pool or unguarded external SMTP/SMS socket.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: TCP pre-check (checkPostgresReachable with 350ms timeout) + instant local store fallback in auth.service.js and server.js ensures login and onboarding respond in <50ms.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Invalid prisma invocation when passing string IDs like 'usr_admin_master' or 'tnt_master_default' to Int fields
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Offline/fallback tokens use string identifiers while Prisma schema defines id/tenantId as Int.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: sanitizeIdsForPrisma() in backend/src/core/database/prisma.client.js and protect() in backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.js automatically normalize string IDs to valid integers.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Developer dashboard OTP SMS dispatch shows 'Invalid Prisma' error
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: OTP dispatch endpoint attempted direct Prisma write with unvalidated tenant/user fields when DB was offline.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: POST /api/v1/dev-control/dispatch-otp and POST /api/v1/auth/send-otp validate fields safely and persist OTP records to gbs_persistent_store.json with carrier detection.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: New tenant registration does not appear on Developer Dashboard for verification/approval
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Onboarding form and Developer Dashboard were reading/writing different storage keys or endpoints.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: Unified POST /api/v1/onboarding/register, GET /api/v1/onboarding/registrations, and GET /api/v1/dev-control/onboarding-registrations backed by gbs_persistent_store.json + localStorage sync.

diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.symptom: Teacher topic video upload not visible on Student Dashboard in teacher's absence
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.rootCause: Missing shared backend endpoint and cross-dashboard component state sync.
diagnosticCauseAndFixKnowledgeBase.resolution: ClassTopicVideoPlatform.jsx is mounted in both TeacherDashboard.jsx (mode='TEACHER') and StudentDashboard.jsx (mode='STUDENT'), syncing via /api/v1/topic-videos and gbs_class_topic_videos.
